model_annotations.Bulgarian: The plot titled "Massive Activation of baseline" displays the maximum activation values across different layers of a neural network, with the x-axis representing the layer number ranging from 0 to 22 on a linear scale, marked at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the "Max Activation Value," ranging from 0 to 1600 on a linear scale, with tick marks every 200 units. Four distinct lines are plotted: a blue dashed line labeled "attn_output," an orange dotted line labeled "attn_residual," a green dash-dotted line labeled "ffn_output," and a red solid line labeled "ffn_residual." The red solid line ("ffn_residual") remains near zero until layer 5, where it sharply increases to approximately 1400, stays relatively constant until layer 21, then drops back to around 400 at layer 22. The orange dotted line ("attn_residual") follows a similar pattern, rising to about 1500 at layer 6, remaining high until layer 21, then decreasing to around 1200 at layer 22. The green dash-dotted line ("ffn_output") starts near zero, spikes to around 1400 at layer 5, drops to near zero by layer 7, rises again to about 1000 at layer 13, drops to near zero by layer 15, and then spikes again to around 1200 at layer 21 before dropping to near zero at layer 22. The blue dashed line ("attn_output") remains near zero until layer 21, where it rises to approximately 200 at layer 22. All lines exhibit sharp transitions at specific layers, indicating abrupt changes in activation values.
